server_count.description: Number of NSD server worker processes. Typically set to the number of CPU cores.

chroot_path.description: Path to chroot directory for security isolation.

zones_dir.description: Directory where zone data files (zonefiles) are stored.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the file where NSD will write its process ID.

log_queries.description: Whether to log every DNS query received (increases log volume).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: 0 (none) to 5 (debug). Higher levels log more details.

tcp_query_count.description: Maximum number of concurrent TCP connections per server process.

tcp_timeout.description: TCP connection idle timeout in seconds.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces (address, port, protocol) on which NSD listens.

remote_control_enable.description: Enable remote control via nsd-control (requires key/cert files).

remote_control_interface.description: Address for the remote control interface (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::1').

remote_control_port.description: Port for the remote control interface.

remote_control_key_file.description: Path to server’s private key file for TLS control channel.

remote_control_cert_file.description: Path to server’s certificate file for TLS control channel.

remote_control_cli_key_file.description: Path to client’s private key (often same as server key for self-signed).

remote_control_cli_cert_file.description: Path to client’s certificate (often same as server cert).

zone_list_file.description: Optional path to a file listing all zonefiles explicitly (alternative to zones-dir). Leave blank to use zones-dir.

zones.description: List of zone configurations (name, zonefile, allow-query, etc.).
